_: x2: SvelteKit (kit 2.70) + Svelte 5 runes only, Tailwind v4 CSS-first via @theme in src/app.css, Cloudflare Workers, Qdrant collection 'x2live'. pnpm only. NEVER start the dev server. House rules: snake_case names, single-letter payload keys, no comments unless they explain a non-obvious WHY, all UI-facing text lowercase, Tailwind utilities only (no inline style=, no <style> blocks, no raw css values — use src/app.css tokens). GOAL: a user can unset their country and state, and a room owner can unset a room's. THE ROOT CAUSE, already traced: src/lib/components/Select.svelte builds its listbox straight from the `options` prop, which never holds an empty-valued entry — so once a country or state is picked there is no row to pick that puts the value back to ''. The `placeholder` is display-only. Everything else is downstream of that. THE STORED SHAPE IS THE EMPTY STRING, NOT A MISSING KEY — do not change this. src/lib/server/group.ts apply_location already writes `updates.country || ''`, and update_group persists a location-only edit through set_payload, which MERGES and therefore cannot delete a key at all. Every read path guards on truthiness (`{#if u.co}`, `...(g.co ? {country: g.co} : {})`, `if (loc.country) clauses.push(...)`), so '' already reads as unset everywhere. Server side needs NO change: save_profile's `co: data.country ?? cur.co` passes '' straight through (?? only falls back on null/undefined), and group.test.ts already has a passing test 'clears a location when given an empty string'. GATES: `pnpm check` has 14 pre-existing errors, so never gate on it directly — gate with `bash plan/check_baseline.sh`, which allows up to 15. Full suite is `pnpm test` (vitest, 1168 passing at plan time). Two vitest projects: src/lib/components/** and *.svelte.test.ts run in jsdom, everything else in node. If rtk hides a vitest failure's detail, rerun as `rtk proxy pnpm vitest run`. Production is https://x2.apexlinks.workers.dev and Cloudflare Workers Builds auto-deploys on push to master.

select_clear.s: Give src/lib/components/Select.svelte a clear row. When `value` is a non-empty string, the listbox renders one extra option ABOVE the real ones, labelled with the `placeholder` text, that commits ''. When `value` is '' it is absent — there is nothing to clear. No new prop: every Select in this repo is an optional field (country, state, gender x2), so this is unconditional on purpose. TRAP: `commit(i)`, `selected_index`, `open_list`'s `highlighted`, the typeahead's `options.indexOf`, and the `{#each}` key all index the `options` prop today. Introduce one derived rows array and route every one of them through it, or clicking an option commits its neighbour. Keep `aria-selected` false on the clear row. Place the staged test as it is, byte for byte, and do not edit it: `cp plan/tests/src/lib/components/__tests__/select_clear.test.ts.txt src/lib/components/__tests__/select_clear.test.ts`
select_clear.t: bash plan/verify_unset_location.sh && test -f src/lib/components/__tests__/select_clear.test.ts && pnpm test && bash plan/check_baseline.sh

profile_clear.s: Fix the user half in src/routes/app/profile/+page.svelte. 1. The IP-geo prefill is a `$effect` that reads `country` and writes it, so clearing the country instantly refills it from `data.geo` and the clear looks broken. `data.geo` is a plain value from the load, not a promise, so run the prefill exactly once: drop the `$effect` wrapper and do it inline in the script body, right after the `let city = $state(...)` line. Leave the second `$effect`, the locationWarning one, alone. 2. `placeholder="—"` on the gender Select now becomes a clear-row label, so change it to `not set`. 3. Change `anyLabel="country"` on the LocationPicker to `no country`, which reads right both as the empty placeholder and as the clear row. 4. Place the staged test as it is, byte for byte, and do not edit it: `cp plan/tests/src/lib/server/__tests__/profile_clear_location.test.ts.txt src/lib/server/__tests__/profile_clear_location.test.ts`
profile_clear.t: bash plan/verify_unset_location.sh && test -f src/lib/server/__tests__/profile_clear_location.test.ts && ! grep -A1 '\$effect(() => {' src/routes/app/profile/+page.svelte | grep -q 'if (data.geo)' && pnpm test && bash plan/check_baseline.sh

room_clear.s: Fix the room half in src/routes/app/rooms/[id]/+page.svelte. `save_edits` sends `country: ecountry || undefined`, and the same for state and city; JSON.stringify drops an undefined value, so update_group sees the key as absent and keeps the old location forever. Send the raw ecountry, eregion, and ecity strings instead. Also change `anyLabel="country"` to `no country` on that page's LocationPicker and on the room-create one in src/routes/app/rooms/+page.svelte, matching the profile. FENCE: leave `create()` in rooms/+page.svelte sending `|| undefined` — a brand-new room with no location should omit the key, not store ''. Leave the server alone; group.test.ts already proves update_group persists ''.
room_clear.t: bash plan/verify_unset_location.sh && ! grep -q 'ecountry || undefined' 'src/routes/app/rooms/[id]/+page.svelte' && ! grep -q 'anyLabel="country"' src/routes/app/rooms/+page.svelte 'src/routes/app/rooms/[id]/+page.svelte' src/routes/app/profile/+page.svelte && pnpm test && bash plan/check_baseline.sh

profile_geo_guard.s: Found by the live pass: the clear persists (GET /api/profile returned co:'' and st:''), but the profile form resurrects it. The IP-geo prefill in src/routes/app/profile/+page.svelte guards on the local state, `!country`, which is '' both for a user who never set a location and for one who just cleared it. So every reload re-proposes the IP guess and the next save writes it back. Guard on the STORED value instead: `p.co === undefined` means never set, `p.co === ''` means deliberately cleared. Do the same for `p.st` and `p.ci`, each field independently. Leave the locationWarning $effect alone. Place the staged test as it is, byte for byte, and do not edit it: `cp plan/tests/src/routes/app/profile/__tests__/geo_prefill.svelte.test.ts.txt src/routes/app/profile/__tests__/geo_prefill.svelte.test.ts`
profile_geo_guard.t: bash plan/verify_unset_location.sh && test -f src/routes/app/profile/__tests__/geo_prefill.svelte.test.ts && ! grep -q 'if (!country && data.geo.country)' src/routes/app/profile/+page.svelte && pnpm test && bash plan/check_baseline.sh

verify_live.s: Prove it end to end against production, with eyes, not only the suite. Commit and push, then wait for the Cloudflare Workers Builds deploy to land on https://x2.apexlinks.workers.dev. Use the agent-browser skill, signed in as a real account. 1. On /app/profile set a country and a state, save, reload, and confirm both stuck. 2. Clear the country, save, reload, and confirm both country and state stay gone across the reload and did NOT come back from IP geo. 3. Repeat on a room you own: /app/rooms/<id> edit, set then clear, reload. 4. Check /app/user/<your id> no longer prints the country or state rows. Do NOT start a dev server. TRAP that already cost one wrong diagnosis: agent-browser refs go stale on EVERY page change, and a stale ref clicks whatever now holds it — re-snapshot before each ref click, or use `find role button click --name`. The Select list also closes on a synthetic click, so open it with focus then ArrowDown, and pick the clear row with Home then Enter. Block the step if any flow still refills or still shows the old value.
verify_live.t: bash plan/verify_unset_location.sh && pnpm test && pnpm build && bash plan/check_baseline.sh
